description: This Java class defines a SineOscillator that extends SawOscillator, implementing a sine wave generator using a Taylor series approximation for sine calculation.

classes.name: SineOscillator
classes.description: A sine wave oscillator class using Taylor expansion for sine computation, extending SawOscillator.

methods.name: fastSin
methods.description: Computes sine of the current phase using a Taylor series expansion, assuming phase is within [-0.5, 0.5].

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides base method to generate the sine wave value at the current phase, converting a sawtooth to sine.
